Finding F-018: potential underbilling on contract C-2007, SKU MFG-1003 (Crestline Tooling Co). Only some contractual anniversary escalations were applied in billing (PARTIAL_ESCALATION).

Contract basis: Clause A.3 (page 3) sets the base price at USD 128.00 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides an annual 3.5% uplift effective January 1, 2024 and annually thereafter. Expected calculation: USD 128.00 x (1 + 3.5%) x (1 + 3.5%) = USD 137.12. Latest billed unit price: USD 132.48.

Impact: 12 invoice lines, 2025-01-05 to 2025-12-05. Potential underbilling USD 11,743.84; estimated recoverable USD 11,743.84.

Proposed actions (owner: Pricing & Billing Master Data):
1. Apply the missing anniversary escalation in the price master from 2025-01-05.
2. Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for approval.
